For the entire time, we have received the most outstanding service and compassionate care.  It has been a godsend, in particular for my wife, with her complex and long lasting health issues, but not only for her but for me, our daughters and now our granddaughters.  It has meant so much to our family.  We are most thankful for all of the top quality professional advice, understanding and unstinting support that we have received over so many years.  There are few organisations that deliver such standards, but when such dedication and excellence is experienced it is important to highlight it and acknowledge it.

The current staff of Dr Morrison, Dr Stanley and all of their colleagues including the nursing, reception and back up staff have ensured that the well deserved reputation the practice has earned over the years has been maintained today and I am sure will continue to blossom and thrive in the future.

I would like to mention some special praise for young Dr Corry, one of the newest additions to the practice. My wife saw him a couple of weeks ago. His manner, straightforward communication and thoroughness were superb and immediately put her at ease and reassured her.  I am sure he has a very bright future in front of him.
